description: rmAGENT (AgentTokenVault) launch shortlist: EMPTY. Robotmoney (RM) is parked (owner decision 2026-10-21, core issue 1903) because the V4 RM/USDC pool is too thin to trade (see 'parked.measured'). rmAGENT deploys with zero assets, paused, and takes no deposits until a token is added through the timelock (ADR-0004). JSON has no comments, so the RM entry sits in 'parked.entries', which no deploy script, recorder script or vault reads. RM_PARKED is true exactly while 'parked.entries' is not empty: the tests and checks that need RM and its pool read it from here (docs/adr/ADR-0015-rm-parked-from-rmagent-until-market-depth.md and docs/code-review/20261021-code-review-internal-claude-rm-parked-from-rmagent.md name them). Reactivation is moving 'parked.entries[0]' back into 'shortlist' once 'parked.reactivation.criteria' hold, then the steps in 'parked.reactivation.steps'. The RM entry pins the live ROBOTMONEY token by code hash like USDC, on the Uniswap V4 RM/USDC 2.91% pool (the V3 RM pool has no in-range liquidity). V4 has no pool address and a hookless V4 pool records no observations, so a listed RM is priced through the permissionless UniswapV4PriceRecorder, which the agent stage reads from RECORDER_ADDRESS. One list for every chain. swapRouter02 is the Uniswap V3 SwapRouter02 the vault constructor takes; the V4 adapter trades through the PoolManager, not the router. maxSlippageBps raises the vault swap bound to the 500 bps ceiling because the RM pool fee alone is 291 bps.

parked.decision: Owner, 2026-10-21: 'I think we need to provisionally drop Robotmoney from the rmAgent. Comment it out, such that we can bring it back when there is sufficient volume.' Core issue 1903.
parked.reason: The Uniswap RM/USDC pool (fee 2.91 percent) is too thin for the vault swap bound: a 1 USDC buy takes 90 percent of its RM. The deep RM market (about $154,000) is the Uniswap RM/WETH pool the design does not use.

measured.guardVaultAgentMinPoolLiquidity: 1e15, unchanged. The pool is 15 times below it.
measured.unitsNote: The guard is raw liquidity L, which is a different dollar depth at every price. At the RM price measured here (about 2.96e-6 USDC per RM) L 1e15 is only about 1.7 USDC of in-range USDC reserve. The guard cannot tell a 2 dollar pool from a 5,000 dollar pool, so the reactivation criteria are in dollars.

criteria: Depth: the in-range USDC reserve of the RM/USDC pool (L times sqrtPrice, read from the PoolManager at the pool id) is at least 5,000 USD at the live price, and at least 48 times the AGENT per-deposit cap on the frozen sheet. A swap of one cap then stays inside the 209 bps price-impact budget (the 500 bps swap bound minus the 291 bps pool fee), because impact is about swap size divided by reserve.
Volume: the pool trades at least 1,000 USD of volume on each of the last 7 days (about 10 times the per-deposit cap), so the recorder TWAP is formed by real trades and not by one holder.
Price: the pool price is within 5 percent of the RM price implied by the deep Uniswap RM/WETH pool, measured at the same block.
Raw guard: VAULT_AGENT_MIN_POOL_LIQUIDITY stays 1e15 or higher. At the price measured here the dollar depth above needs L of about 2.9e15, so the guard is met and is not the binding limit.
steps: Re-measure the four criteria on Base at one block and record the numbers in a new docs/code-review file.
Move parked.entries[0] into 'shortlist' and set parked.entries to []. RM_PARKED is then false and the RM-pool tests run. Run bun scripts/ci/config-check.ts.
The permissionless price recorder (stage 1b) is already deployed for the parked pool. Start the recorder keeper (scripts/ops/recorder-keeper.sh) and confirm the recorder holds 1800 s of history.

Schedule addAsset(RM) on the deployed rmAGENT through the Safe and the timelock (ADR-0004 SHORTLIST_ADD_DELAY). Deploy the vault swap adapter first and allow its codehash, as DeployAgentTokenVault does.
Run the verifier, the Twin and the fork RM-pool tests with RM_PARKED false and record the result.
